mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals decreased economic output, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 350000 signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decrease in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals a successful inflation targeting, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased wage pressures.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low UNRATE periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met.
